description: This file defines a React custom hook `useProjectUsage` that fetches usage statistics for a specific project from an API endpoint. It manages internal state for data, loading status, and error handling, and provides a refetch function for reloading the data.

methods.name: useProjectUsage(projectId, options = {})
methods.description: A React hook that retrieves usage statistics (`creditsUsed`, `cost`, `currency`) for a specified project, handling loading and error states, and providing a refetch capability.

methods.name: fetchUsage()
methods.description: An internal async function that calls the backend API to fetch project usage data, updating hook state accordingly.
